streams.name: 📱 What is Nuvio? 📱
streams.title: 📱 What is Nuvio? 📱
streams.description: Nuvio is an app that plays Stremio-compatible addons, like Tailliuir Network. If you're using Nuvio instead of Stremio, everything else applies to you too.

streams.name: ❓ How do I install on Nuvio? ❓
streams.title: ❓ How do I install on Nuvio? ❓
streams.description: Open Nuvio → Settings → Addons → Add Addon, then paste the manifest URL. Nuvio has no one-click install — you have to paste the link in manually, one addon at a time.

streams.name: 🔗 Where do I get the link? 🔗
streams.title: 🔗 Where do I get the link? 🔗
streams.description: Every addon on the Tailliuir Studio website has a Copy Link button next to it. Tap that, then paste the copied link into Nuvio's Add Addon field.

streams.name: 🚫 Why doesn't Install do anything? 🚫
streams.title: 🚫 Why doesn't Install do anything? 🚫
streams.description: The Install buttons on the website are built for Stremio's deep links. Nuvio doesn't support that — always use Copy Link and paste it in manually instead.

streams.name: 📶 Does Nuvio need a debrid service? 📶
streams.title: 📶 Does Nuvio need a debrid service? 📶
streams.description: Yes for most sources. Nuvio has no built-in torrent engine, so torrent-based addons only become playable once paired with a debrid service like TorBox.

streams.name: 🔌 Native TorBox integration 🔌
streams.title: 🔌 Native TorBox integration 🔌
streams.description: Nuvio can link TorBox directly under Settings → Integrations → Connected Services, instead of putting an API key into each addon individually.

streams.name: ⚠️ Native debrid vs addon debrid ⚠️
streams.title: ⚠️ Native debrid vs addon debrid ⚠️
streams.description: If you link TorBox natively in Nuvio, your addons need to return raw torrent hashes, not pre-resolved links. If an addon already has a debrid key entered into it, Nuvio's native integration gets bypassed.

streams.name: 📊 Metadata addons come first 📊
streams.title: 📊 Metadata addons come first 📊
streams.description: In Nuvio, keep metadata addons (like AIOMetadata) at the top of your installed list — this is what loads posters and details properly for everything else.

streams.name: 🔀 Can I reorder addons? 🔀
streams.title: 🔀 Can I reorder addons? 🔀
streams.description: Yes — in Settings → Addons, use the up/down arrows to move addons. Higher priority addons show first in your stream results.

streams.name: 🔕 Can I disable without deleting? 🔕
streams.title: 🔕 Can I disable without deleting? 🔕
streams.description: Yes — Nuvio lets you toggle addons on and off individually in Settings → Addons, so you don't have to uninstall and reinstall if you just want to pause one.

streams.name: ⚙️ Where's the settings gear in Nuvio? ⚙️
streams.title: ⚙️ Where's the settings gear in Nuvio? ⚙️
streams.description: Tap the gear icon next to an installed addon in Settings → Addons to open its configuration page in your browser — same idea as the Stremio settings wheel.

streams.name: 🔁 Do I need to reinstall backups every time? 🔁
streams.title: 🔁 Do I need to reinstall backups every time? 🔁
streams.description: No — install the backup addons once and just leave them lower in your priority order. They'll sit there quietly until TorBox goes down and you need them.
